inputs: Six original business-result JSONs plus normal-mode audited saved CSV/attempt/terminal; declared architecture source files used as static identity only. No private trajectory is transferred to desktop.
semantics: Public state judgements at actual availability times and private initial event truth are separate. Counts, not calibrated sample accuracy. Unmodeled cause has no known truth denominator; zero applicable denominator yields null rate. Original failed assertion and tool-mode gaps remain preserved.
checks: Frozen Git inputs/tool and actual source guard before/after; no optimized interpreter; CSV matches saved event table; automatic canvas text bounds and actual PNG view recorded separately.
failure_rule: Unique output with attempt and terminal, retain any rendering failure; no automatic rerender.
durable_set: Pinned renderer, protocol, stage tool, selected original data and architecture source; manifest, job, attempt, terminal/logs, CSV and PNG/SVG; actual-view record. Runtime caches excluded.
